rows.headline: Vedanta and HDFC AMC among seven stocks at risk of slipping into midcap in AMFI H1 CY27 rejig

rows.summary: Seven major stocks including Vedanta, HDFC AMC, Godrej Consumer Products, Tata Consumer Products, and Indus Towers are projected to lose their largecap status during the upcoming AMFI H1 CY27 categorization review due to rising market-cap thresholds. The Association of Mutual Funds in India periodically updates stock classifications based on average market capitalization over a six-month period. A drop from largecap to midcap forces mutual funds to rebalance their portfolios to align with mandated fund allocation rules. Indian retail investors with exposure to these specific funds or stocks may see portfolio adjustments as institutional holdings shift.
